physical_definition: Fix r39 shared winds, common-mass two-branch moisture transport (lower mass fraction .25, upper/lower humidity ratio .2,1km thermal shear), and all rainfall/planetary parameters. Existing conservative storm closure takes6 nonnegative short hops, each Gaussian width reduced by sqrt(6); local capacity is existing crest saturation / eddy_rainout. Hops-only uses1e-6 as a practically unlimited capacity: report actual condensation at every primer/scored step, do not assume it vanishes. Compare fixed strengths .5/.75 to isolate condensation from changed transport geometry. Vapor plus local condensate is conserved; condensate remains at formation cells. Same finite-step redistribution, not a resolved storm trajectory. These choices repeat established operator-attribution values under a newly corrected transport basis, rather than refining the failed wind search.
